name: rating
summary: Drag across the stars to rate; the top one throws a little spark burst.
props: Half-icon precision when tapping or dragging.
Display only; fractional values (4.3) fill partially.
Tap the current value again to reset to 0.
Star or heart icons; heart switches the default fill to danger.
Selection tick for every step while tapping or dragging.
Style for the row of icons.
behavior: Tap or drag across the row to set the value, to half-icon precision with allowHalf. With clearable, tapping the current value clears it.
Icons fill smoothly and pop in a quick stagger with a wobble. When you raise the rating, the top icon throws a spark burst.
A selection tick plays for every step while tapping or dragging.
One adjustable element read as 'N of 5'. Swipe up or down to change it by one step.
Works with the mouse too, and shows a pointer cursor while interactive.
